From the Mayor's Desk
---------------------

The city of Kittitas welcomes you. Established in 1883 as part of the westward expansion of the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul, and Pacific Railroad. We are located in central Washington where we enjoy four seasons punctuated by crisp cold winters and nice warm dry summers. Come check us out!

![image](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/images/flyer_timeline2.png)

Phone: (509) 968-0220
**Front Office Hours: Mon - Thur 8am to 6pm - (Closed Fridays)**
